notes.subject: ועננים
notes.rationale: פועל ענן i tok long man i lukluk long sta / wokim posin — ol tanim tok i tok 'soothsayers' o 'sorcerers'

notes.subject: ישפיקו
notes.rationale: ספק i tok 'clap han' (pasim han long kontrak) o 'fulap long' — mi usim 'pasim han' olsem YLT/ASV

notes.subject: עמך
notes.rationale: את i stap long Heb hia bihain נטשתה? — no, ⟨את⟩ i no stap long tekst; mak ⟨את⟩ i no gat — rausim

translation: Long wanem, Yu rausim ⟨את⟩ ol man bilong yu, haus bilong Yakov, long wanem, ol i fulap long ol pasin bilong saut bilong san, na ol man bilong lukluk long ol sta olsem Pelistim, na ol i pasim han wantaim ol pikinini bilong ol man bilong narapela ples.

tokens.gloss: long ol pasin bilong saut bilong san
na ol man bilong lukluk long ol sta
